what: The recorded soft-scale checks (python -m fleetreserve.soft_scale_check) that item t8 of passmarks/wp9.sh combines, read by tools/wp9_check.py at the checked-out commit (its reading W3e): every listed run is required, each with the run label, model, configuration and committed matrix it must have, and, where an entry names it, its days per unit (days_per_unit, the command's --days, at least the command's default 100; absent: 100); a label begins with wp9-soft-scale-check- and has the form the run recorder allows. The two runs on gate/matrix.json check the development units; the two on gate/t8-training-a.json and gate/t8-training-b.json check training-site days, four training units each in a rotation what-if, with lgbm_tail_rotation fitted on the other four.
